author: VANSMITHLAB
title: Field Operations
summary: A landscape practice in New York since 1998. It treats landscape as infrastructure capable of changing neighbourhood economics, ecology, movement and urban image simultaneously.

hero_image.alt: A large site plan pinned to the wall above a laminated contour model, pressed plant specimens and jars of soil samples.
hero_image.caption: Plan, terrain and soil in one view: landscape designed from the ground it actually sits on.
